fns.desc: sae_pk_set_password never caps password length; tmp->fingerprint[SAE_MAX_HASH_LEN=64] can overflow via unbounded `*pos++=` writes when fingerprint_bits (derived from strlen(password)) exceeds 512 bits. sae_password is a heap string with no length cap in config.c. Requires an unusually long local config value, not remote wire data, but no bounds check exists.
